subject.title: WebChat persists internal records and loses durable turn status

question: Should WebChat guarantee a durable, replayable per-turn terminal state and an explicit older-history recovery path, beyond fixing any confirmed internal-record filtering defect?
rationale: The requested durable status model and history-navigation behavior are user-facing product contracts, not a mechanically determined consequence of the reported persistence symptoms.

options.title: Separate confirmed bugs from UX contract
options.body: First reproduce and repair record filtering or replay defects, then define durable turn-state and history-navigation requirements in a scoped follow-up.

options.title: Treat all reports as one WebChat redesign
options.body: Adopt a broader transcript/state redesign only after an owner confirms the desired persistence and pagination contract.

recommendation.title: Separate confirmed bugs from UX contract
recommendation.body: First reproduce and repair record filtering or replay defects, then define durable turn-state and history-navigation requirements in a scoped follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: No feature-history owner could be identified in the unavailable repository inspection; the reporter can provide the initial evidence needed for routing.
